subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41265 as the canonical fix path for this issue, or replace it with a fresh narrow PR?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the remaining choice is how to handle the stale proof-blocked linked branch and its SDK/media-delivery contract concerns.

options.title: Refresh the linked PR
options.body: Keep the contributor PR as canonical, resolve its merge/proof/API-contract blockers, and close this issue only after it merges.

options.title: Replace with a narrow PR
options.body: Open a current-main replacement that preserves the useful MIME/WebP fix and credit the source work before superseding the linked branch.

options.title: Leave parked
options.body: Keep the issue open without a new repair lane until a maintainer is ready to sponsor the Discord media fix path.

recommendation.title: Refresh the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep the contributor PR as canonical, resolve its merge/proof/API-contract blockers, and close this issue only after it merges.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across the Discord send helper and media optimization surfaces involved in the branch decision.
